scope: time difficulty only; top-left horizontal 1/2/3 gold five-point stars

images.name: 初级
images.prompt: Precise additive EDIT of the supplied gold Minesweeper TIME medal. The input image is the edit target: the approved frameless ascending ZIGZAG ARROW and a single five-point star in the upper-left. Change ONLY the UPPER-LEFT difficulty star marker. Preserve the original arrow, every bend, tip, tail, existing surrounding gold angular fragments, exact positions, scale, metallic facets, bevels, modeled depth, highlights and gold color. Keep the same square canvas, transparent negative spaces, and original artwork placement. REPLACE the existing large corner star with a row of SMALLER matching upright five-point GOLD STARS. Each star has exactly FIVE outer points, one point straight up, a plump filled center with broad sturdy points and restrained gold facets matching the input star. All stars are identical in size, material, orientation and lighting. Each star is about 18% of total canvas width and height. Arrange the stars in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW in the empty upper-left region, centered vertically around y=22% of canvas height. The FIRST star is always centered at x=16%; if present the SECOND star is centered at x=38%; if present the THIRD star is centered at x=60%. Keep a clear transparent gap between stars; stars never touch the original arrow or fragments. Keep the first star position and size identical in all three variants; do not center or enlarge a shorter row. No surrounding circular plate, rectangular backing, enclosing frame, ribbon, bars, extra little stars, sparkles, text, numbers, labels or letters. Do not add any symbol at the bottom. All background must remain genuinely transparent alpha, not black or white or baked checkerboard. Output ONE isolated medal, not a grid. Exact star count for this output: EXACTLY 1 five-point star total in the upper-left difficulty row. Use ONLY the first position. No second or third star.
